schema.comment: CFB 27 schema will NOT ship with madden-franchise at launch. Day-1 steps: (1) extract franchise-schemas.ftx from the game with Frosty, (2) generate a schema via madden-franchise's schemaGenerator/generateSchemaV2, (3) point schemaDirectory at the folder containing it (or schemaOverride at the exact file).

tables.comment: UNKNOWN until launch. Run `node cli.js inspect <cfb27 save>` to dump real table names, then fill definitions. CFB tables may use college-specific names (e.g. recruiting, transfer portal, NIL). Start from the Madden config and adjust.
